claims.claim_text: We employ L1 loss for both the sub-pixel refinement and speed estimate outputs.
claims.normalized_text: Use L1 loss for sub-pixel refinement and speed estimate outputs.

claims.claim_text: During training, the model is provided the past motion history as one of the inputs.
claims.normalized_text: Model input during training includes past motion history.

claims.claim_text: The net can learn to cheat by extrapolating from the past rather than finding the underlying causes of the behavior.
claims.normalized_text: Model may cheat by extrapolating past motion instead of learning behavior causes.

claims.claim_text: During closed-loop inference, the past history is from the net’s own past predictions, which can cause the model to fail to stop for a stop sign if it only learns to stop when seeing deceleration in past history.
claims.normalized_text: Closed-loop inference uses net's past predictions, causing failure to stop if model relies only on past deceleration.

claims.claim_text: We introduce a dropout on the past pose history, where for 50% of the examples, we keep only the current position of the agent in the past agent poses channel of the input data.
claims.normalized_text: Apply dropout on past pose history by keeping only current position in 50% of examples.
